\[
R(x,y) = \max_{w \in W_{xy}} w - \min_{w \in W_{xy}} w
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(W_{xy}\): The window around (x, y)

The largest minus the smallest value of the window. It is the max filter minus the min filter, the morphological gradient with a flat square. A single outlier in the window sets it.
